basic.name: Holy Light
basic.description: Heal target allied Hero for 362~~0.04~~ Health. When used on a target other than Uther, also heal Uther for 181~~0.04~~ Health.

basic.name: Holy Radiance
basic.description: Heal all allied Heroes and Minions in a line for 194~~0.04~~ Health, dealing 177~~0.04~~ damage to enemies.

basic.name: Hammer of Justice
basic.description: Deal 109~~0.04~~ damage and Stun the target for 1 second.

heroic.name: Divine Shield
heroic.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Divine Storm
heroic.description: Deal 170~~0.04~~ damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

trait.name: Devotion
trait.description:
Uther's Basic Abilities grant 25 Armor to allied Heroes, and 15 to Uther, for 2 seconds.

Eternal Vanguard

Upon dying, Uther becomes an Invulnerable spirit for up to 8 seconds. While in spirit form, Uther can heal allies with Flash of Light for 230~~0.04~~.

activable.name: Spell Shield - Disabled
activable.description:
Spell Shield is disabled and will not trigger.

Click this button to enable Spell Shield.

activable.name: Holy Shock
activable.description: Activate to deal 145~~0.04~~ damage to the target enemy, and gain the self-healing benefits of Holy Light. Shares a cooldown with Holy Light

activable.name: Armor of Faith
activable.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

activable.name: Hand of Protection
activable.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

activable.name: Benediction
activable.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level1.name: Silver Touch
level1.description:
Quest: Reduce damage from Heroic sources with Devotion.

Reward: After reducing damage 40 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced from 80 to 60.

Reward: After reducing damage 80 times, Holy Light's Mana cost is reduced to 40, and its range is increased by 50%.

level1.name: Wave of Light
level1.description:
Quest: Damage or heal Heroes 60 times with Holy Radiance.

Reward: Increase the duration of Devotion by 0.5 seconds.

Passive: Damaging or healing Heroes with Holy Radiance refunds 5 Mana and reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level1.name: Hammer of the Lightbringer
level1.description:
Quest: Basic Attack enemies 75 times.

Reward: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hammer of Justice by 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Basic Attacks restore 1.5% of Uther's maximum Mana.

level4.name: Holy Shock
level4.description: Activate to deal 145~~0.04~~ damage to the target enemy, and gain the self-healing benefits of Holy Light. Shares a cooldown with Holy Light.

level4.name: Pursuit of Justice
level4.description: Hammer of Justice increases Uther's Movement Speed by 25% for 3 seconds.

level4.name: Holy Fire
level4.description: Deal 13~~0.04~~ damage per second to nearby enemies. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes increase this damage by 20% for 3 seconds. This can stack up to 3 times.

level7.name: Armor of Faith
level7.description: Being Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants Uther 90 Mana and causes Holy Light's cooldown to recharge 200% faster for 6 seconds. This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

level7.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
level7.description: Healing a Hero with a Basic Ability that is Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced grants them 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

level7.name: Hand of Protection
level7.description: Activate to make target ally Unstoppable for 1 second. Cannot be cast on Uther. Basic Attacks reduce Hand of Protection's cooldown by 5 seconds.

level10.name: Divine Shield
level10.description: Make an allied Hero Invulnerable and increase their Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level10.name: Divine Storm
level10.description: Deal 170~~0.04~~ damage and Stun nearby enemies for 1.75 seconds.

level13.name: Blessed Champion
level13.description: For the next 5 seconds after using Holy Light, Uther's Basic Attacks heal him and nearby allied Heroes for 15% of the total amount healed by Holy Light.

level13.name: Well Met
level13.description: When used against Heroes, Hammer of Justice reduces the target's Movement Speed and damage dealt by 25% for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Spell Shield
level13.description:
Every 30 seconds, gain 50 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 3 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level16.name: Beacon of Light
level16.description: Uther receives 125% bonus self-healing when targeting others with Holy Light. This bonus is increased to 250% while he is below 50% Health.

level16.name: Tyr's Deliverance
level16.description: Increase the damage and healing of Holy Radiance by 10%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes cause Uther's next cast of Holy Radiance to have its damage and healing increased by an additional 10%, stacking up to 7 times.

level16.name: Benediction
level16.description: Activate to reduce the Mana cost of Uther's next Basic Ability by 50 and its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level20.name: Bulwark of Light
level20.description: Divine Shield is also applied to all nearby allied Heroes and lasts 1 second longer.

level20.name: Divine Hurricane
level20.description: Divine Storm's radius is increased by 50% and its cooldown is reduced by 40 seconds.

level20.name: Redemption
level20.description:
After Eternal Vanguard ends, Uther revives at the spirit's location with 50% of his maximum Health.

This effect has a 180 second cooldown.

level20.name: Divine Protection
level20.description: Increase Devotion Armor to 50 and its duration by 0.5 seconds.
